parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: Correct ordered back-to-back display with Lions left, Tigers right, and a key such as $1|18|3$ means 181 cm for Lions and 183 cm for Tigers.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use stems $16,17,18,19,20$ and enter every given height on the correct side. [B1]
Guidance: Correct common stems; an upside-down stem order is acceptable, but leaves must not be reversed.
Label Lions on the left and order its leaves from right to left. [B1]
Guidance: Lions must be labelled on the left, with its leaves ordered from right to left and aligned.
Label Tigers on the right and order its leaves from left to right. [B1]
Guidance: Tigers must be on the same display, with ordered aligned leaves; transpose both data sets counts as one error only.
Key: $1\mid18\mid3$ means $181$ cm for Lions and $183$ cm for Tigers. [B1]
Guidance: One key must identify both teams, the place value and cm; two separate displays can earn only the official special-case key marks.
Total: 4
